title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials warn residents to avoid Ames Pond after a dog died, potentially due to an algae bloom.
Despite E. Coli tests being clear, cyanobacterial algae blooms are suspected and can be harmful to humans and pets.
Stoughton Board of Health advises residents to keep pets out of Ames Pond as monitoring and tests continue.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH trooper James Lamoureux pleaded guilty to false reports about using GPS to track his girlfriend.
Lamoureux placed tracking devices on both his and his girlfriend's vehicles and claimed someone else did it.
He resigned from the state police and will be on the national registry of decertified officers, ineligible for law enforcement employment.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a report of a shirtless man with a gun outside Grace Chapel.
The man, an avid period reenactor, was polishing a musket-era powder horn, not wielding a gun.
The incident led to a heavy police response and lockdown, but posed no real threat to the public.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Sports analyst Rob Parker doubts the Red Sox will make the playoffs despite their recent success.
The Red Sox posted a 32-5 record since June 25, holding the second A.L. wild-card spot.
FanGraphs puts the Red Sox's playoff chances at 96%, with a 12.6% chance of winning the A.L. East.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu, Red Sox player, was scratched from Saturday's lineup due to leg swelling from a Friday night hit.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Wilyer Abreu will return for the Red Sox game against the Athletics on Sunday at 1:35 p.m.
Abreu has a .256 batting average and 20 home runs this season, ranking second in RBIs on the team with 62.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Oakland Athletics.
Red Sox pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, contributing to the loss.
Despite the defeat, the Red Sox maintain second place in the AL wild-card standings, 1.5 games behind the Yankees.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf surface again following a procedural NFL rule and missed testing window.
The current turf did not pass NFL laboratory protocols due to the absence of an 'E-layer', necessitating its replacement.
The new installation will use the turf version from 2025, used by both the Patriots and Revolution.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium on Saturday.
Jack Harrison made his club debut for New England, entering in the 55th minute amid preseason form.
Houston's goals came from Guilherme and Agustin Resch, capitalizing on New England's defensive errors and counter-attacks.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony, out since May with a wrist injury, is training with a pitching machine to increase velocity.
Adley Rutschman made a rehab appearance for Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings and showing defensive skills.
Rutschman expected to be everyday catcher upon return, while Anthony's return may affect Jarren Duran's starting role.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless', 'Eighth Grade', and 'Something's Gotta Give' are among Netflix's top streaming films for August 2026.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' releases on Paramount+, featuring Aang and a new story involving a powerful ancient warrior.
Boston.com staff recommend 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 on Paramount+ and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 on Apple TV.
